description: Run Omarchy on MacOS without any setup.

latest_release.name: v1.2.0
latest_release.body:
This release brings a new native macOS launcher, browser swipe navigation, and input source switching for Korean, Chinese and Japanese Macs 💻 You can upgrade by replacing the app with the new `TryOmarchy.dmg`. Your VM and its files are kept, and Omarchy inside the VM keeps updating with `omarchy update`. # Features * New native launcher that follows Light and Dark mode, laid out like System Settings with a sidebar by @themartiano in #364 * Two-finger swipes go back and forward in browsers, like on the Mac by @sscarduzio, @themartiano in #401, #412 * Caps Lock is the 한/영 key on Korean Macs by @AI-Dico, @themartiano in #404, #410 * Omarchy's input method follows the Mac's input source for Chinese and Japanese, and Globe switches it while the VM is focused by @themartiano in #411 * The launcher shows each step while preparing the Omarchy image, with a progress bar in place of the Launch button by @themartiano in #398, #413 # Fixes * The keyboard works in Limine's boot menu by @themartiano in #409 * ⌘C, ⌘V and ⌘W no longer type a plain key while the keyboard is captured by @stevederico in #279 * The guest clock recovers as soon as the Mac wakes, and the top bar clock redraws right away instead of up to a minute later by @themartiano in #391 * Bring back the battery percentage toggle in the Omarchy menu, after Omarchy split it into two rows by @themartiano in #408 ## Dev * Fix a QEMU crash when the Cocoa display starts a VM with no console by @charles-hood in #312 * Rewrite the docs around the shell principles, with a user manual, contributor docs and agent instructions by @themartiano in #395 * Improve the README by @themartiano
--- Full changelog: [v1.1.0...v1.2.0](https://github.com/omacom/try-omarchy/compare/v1.1.0...v1.2.0) Just download `TryOmarchy.dmg`, the rest of the installation will be handled automatically 👇

detail.readme_excerpt:
Try Omarchy

Omarchy inside Apple's Ecosystem.

Try Omarchy is a Mac app that runs stock Omarchy in a fast virtual machine deeply integrated with macOS. Use it as your daily driver, or give Omarchy a try and migrate to a native install. Integrations include Apple's universal clipboard, AirPods, Touch ID, the Retina display, Super shortcuts, Mac clipboard, audio, camera, battery, and a shared folder. The official Omarchy Mac image is used, so it behaves and updates like any other Omarchy install. ## Get started 1. Download the latest `.dmg` from [Releases](https://github.com/omacom/try-omarchy/releases). 2. Drag **Try Omarchy** to **Applications** and open it. 3. Optionally configure permissions for the full experience. 3. Click **Launch Omarchy**. The first launch downloads the Omarchy image (about 3 GB). You need an Apple Silicon Mac with macOS 15 or newer and about 15 GB of free space. ## How it works - **Omarchy is stock.** The VM runs the official `aarch64` Omarchy from Omarchy's own repositories. Try Omarchy adds one package, `try-omarchy`, and changes no file that Omarchy owns. - **Omarchy updates itself.** Run `omarchy update`, or use **Update → Omarchy**, whenever you like. Each update takes a snapshot first, so you can roll back from the boot menu. - **The app updates the Mac integrations.** Each app release brings a newer, local `try-omarchy` package, which the VM installs at its next boot. - **Edge channel for now.** Omarchy publishes for ARM on `edge` only. ## What you get - Native CPU speed through Apple's Hypervisor framework, and GPU-accelerated graphics - A full-screen or windowed desktop that follows your display's resolution, scaling and supports the notch - Command works as Super. Mac keyboard layouts are mapped correctly - Two-way clipboard for text and images - Mac audio output and microphone, with live device switching - The Mac camera, available to Omarchy as a webcam - The Mac's battery in the Omarchy bar, including detailed information - One shared Mac folder, under the same name (`~/Work` stays `~/Work`) - Touch ID for `sudo` and 1Password - Port forwarding, SSH, bridged networking and USB passthrough (experimental) **Limitations:** - Video decoding uses the CPU, so multiple high-resolution playback can stutter. - Vulkan is not available. - Nested virtualization is opt-in for now. ## Manual Settings live in the launcher. Once Omarchy is running, open them with **Setup → Try Omarchy Settings**.
